description: Defines the QuicTcpLikeTraceConverter class for converting sent QUIC frames to connection byte offsets, including related data structures and methods.

classes.name: QuicTcpLikeTraceConverter
classes.description: A class that converts sent QUIC frames into connection byte offsets, similar to TCP sequence numbers.

methods.name: OnCryptoFrameSent
methods.description: Handles a sent crypto frame, returning the corresponding connection offsets.

methods.name: OnStreamFrameSent
methods.description: Handles a sent stream frame, returning the corresponding connection offsets.

methods.name: OnControlFrameSent
methods.description: Handles a sent control frame, returning the corresponding connection offsets.
